name: last-flame
description: Last Flame: a little flame with seconds to live. Nine levels of running, jumping and dashing; burn lamps for more time; carry the fire to the Eternal Fire.

scripts.check: for f in server.mjs shared/*.js src/*.js test/*.mjs tools/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && node tools/build.mjs && cd dist && zip -q last-flame-web.zip index.html && zip -q last-flame-download.zip LastFlame.html && rm index.html && ls
